summary: IdP issuer namespace variation causes tenant resolution to fail after IdP-initiated SSO
summary_detail: After configuring IdP-initiated SSO for BrightEdge Health's private deployment, users receive 403s because the platform fails to resolve tenant-scoped role bindings when the SAML Issuer value includes a trailing namespace suffix.
description:
Issue summary: Customers cannot complete IdP-initiated SSO. Auth succeeds at IdP but Redwood returns 403 during post-login authorization.

Impact: ~120 users at BrightEdge Health unable to access the private console or call private endpoints; blocked for administrative workflows. Incident started after SSO onboarding on 2026-03-10 09:15 UTC.

Environment: Private deployment (VPC) for BrightEdge Health; auth flows go through customer identity proxy + Redwood private control plane in us-east. SAML IdP: on-prem ADFS cluster (SAML 2.0).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Admin configures SAML IdP with EntityID set to https://idp.brightedge.example/auth/tenant/bh-42 (note trailing tenant segment)
2) Enable IdP-initiated SSO in console with the exact EntityID value provided by customer
3) User clicks IdP-initiated login URL at IdP and successfully authenticates
4) After redirect to Redwood, user sees 403 and "tenant resolution failed" in UI

Observed logs (redacted):
- identity-proxy: "received SAML assertion issuer='https://idp.brightedge.example/auth/tenant/bh-42'"
- auth-service: "tenant_lookup: no_match for issuer='https://idp.brightedge.example/auth/tenant/bh-42'"
- rbac-service: "subject lookup failed -> returning 403"

Hypothesis: The identity-proxy normalizes issuer values by stripping path suffixes in a previous compatibility patch (INT-4129). The customer's IdP uses a tenant-scoped EntityID (includes tenant namespace in path). Normalization removed the tenant suffix when constructing the issuer key, so tenant lookup fell back to global issuer and did not match tenant-scoped role bindings.

Initial workaround: Customer can configure IdP to use a canonical EntityID without the tenant path (if feasible) or temporarily create a global issuer mapping in Redwood console pointing to the stripped issuer. We advised the customer to avoid changing IdP metadata until we've pushed a fix.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer configured SAML EntityID with tenant suffix
Enabled IdP-initiated SSO with that EntityID
User authenticates at IdP and is redirected back
Redwood returns 403 and logs tenant_lookup no_match
investigation_notes: Confirmed identity-proxy behavior by replaying assertion in staging
Found normalization logic in proxy that strips URI path segments after hostname (introduced in INT-4129)
Reproduced tenant resolution failure in staging by sending issuer with '/tenant/<id>' suffix
Checked RBAC store: bindings exist for the full issuer string with tenant suffix; no binding for stripped issuer
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Priya Nair (Support): Customer reports IdP-initiated SSO results in 403 immediately after login. Screenshots and SAML assertion attached. Asked for assertion sample and metadata XML.

2026-03-10 11:05 - Ethan Holt (SRE): Replayed assertion in staging. Identity-proxy log shows issuer normalization: 'https://idp.brightedge.example' (path removed). RBAC lookup uses normalized issuer; tenant-specific bindings not matched. Hypothesis: normalization is too aggressive for tenant-scoped EntityIDs.

2026-03-10 13:30 - Customer (BrightEdge Health - SSO Admin): Confirmed their IdP EntityID intentionally includes '/tenant/bh-42' to support multi-tenant ADFS routing. Unable to change on short timeline.

2026-03-10 15:40 - Ethan Holt (SRE): Applied temporary mapping in private control plane: created alias mapping from normalized issuer to full issuer for BrightEdge Health tenant. Verified admin user could log in and access console. Noted mapping is a workaround and needs product fix to avoid manual mappings at scale.

2026-03-11 09:22 - Engineering (Identity): Created PR to change normalization behavior: preserve full issuer by default, but add an optional flag to canonicalize for known legacy IdPs. PR linked above. Asked for canary deployment in staging.
2026-03-12 14:05 - Customer: Confirmed full user population can authenticate after workaround. Asked for permanent fix timeline and whether other tenants are at risk.

2026-03-12 17:00 - Ethan Holt (SRE): Deployed fix to private control plane for BrightEdge Health and staged rollout to other private tenants. Identity proxy now preserves full issuer path unless admin enables legacy canonicalization. Monitoring for unusual login errors for 48 hours. Marking ticket resolved after customer verification.

2026-03-14 10:00 - Priya Nair (Support): Follow-up note: Add onboarding doc section recommending customers use stable EntityIDs and documenting how to request issuer aliasing if IdP cannot change EntityID. Created CON-SSO-ONBOARD follow-up action.
resolution: Fixed: Reverted aggressive issuer normalization in identity-proxy and introduced explicit aliasing feature in private control plane. Rolled out hotfix for BrightEdge Health on 2026-03-12; global rollout started same day. Workaround (manual alias) removed after validation. Follow-up: update onboarding docs to cover tenant-scoped EntityIDs.
